fockus-skill-memory-bank-root.description: Agent-agnostic long-term project memory through `.memory-bank/` + RULES (TDD/SOLID/Clean Architecture/FSD/Mobile) + dev-toolkit commands. Use when working in a project with a `.memory-bank/` directory or when the user explicitly asks for memory-bank workflow, code rules, or dev-toolkit commands (`/mb`, plan, spec, verify, done; «память проекта», «контекст проекта», «план», «продолжай по плану»).
